title: Garden and Spire Again
author: Dominic Zhou
blurb: Felix Yarrow, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
